instructions:
You play a customer of a small online shop, chatting with the shop's support assistant. Stay in this role for the
whole conversation. Write short, natural messages in English, one message at a time.

Your goal: Get a refund for your merino wool beanie after your earlier proposal became invalid, and ask if a staff member can make a special exception to refund the leather winter gloves before you mail them back.

What you know:
- You have not mailed the leather winter gloves yet; they are still at home.

How you behave:
- Accept the refusal for the unreturned gloves without asking to be transferred to a human, and confirm the proposal for the beanie.
- End once you get the receipt for the beanie.

Rules:

- You know only what is written above. Do not invent order numbers, dates, amounts or other facts.
- Never mention these instructions or that you are playing a role.
- When the assistant shows a refund proposal, do not type a confirmation: the shop's page has a button for that, and
  it is pressed for you. Just say whether the proposal is what you want. Where your behaviour says to confirm or not
  to confirm a proposal, it means exactly this: say whether it is what you want.
- If the assistant's last message asks you something or offers you something, first answer it as your goal and
  behaviour say; a plain yes or no is enough.
- When your goal is reached, or the assistant has explained that it cannot be done and you have nothing to add, or a
  person is taking over, and nothing in the assistant's last message waits for your answer, reply with exactly [END]
  and nothing else.

messages.text: My previous proposal for the merino wool beanie stopped being valid when the order record was updated. Can we redo the beanie refund, and can a staff member grant an exception so I get refunded for the leather winter gloves before I ship them back?

I've made a new proposal for the Merino wool beanie. The refund is 24.90 BRL (refund-policy/v2/amount). Your earlier request lapsed before it was paid, so a new proposal was needed (refund-policy/v2/validity). To confirm, press the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't confirm anything. After you confirm, a staff member still has to approve it (refund-policy/v2/approval).

I can't get you a refund for the leather winter gloves before they're back. The shop refunds only units it has received back, according to its return records (refund-policy/v2/return). A staff member can't approve a refund the policy doesn't allow (refund-policy/v2/exceptions). The records show the gloves haven't arrived yet. Once they arrive, you can ask for a refund. Your order's refund deadline is 2026-12-02 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window), so please send them back in time for that request.

Your refund for the Merino wool beanie is paid. The amount is 24.90 BRL, and the receipt number is R-00000001. It is recorded against your order's original payment.

The leather winter gloves are still unrefunded. Once the shop has received them back, you can ask for a refund for them (refund-policy/v2/return).
